name: Rasamanikya

sections.reference_siddha_bheshaja_manimala_jwara: Rasamanikya is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet and powder form. This herbal powder is used in the treatment of fever, bronchitis, Asthma etc. This medicine contains heavy metal as an ingredient, hence take it strictly under medical supervision. It balances the Vata and Kapha doshas in the body.
sections.ingredients:
Shuddha haratala (arsenic trioxide) and mica sheets. 
 Method of preparation 
 Small pieces of Purified Haratala (Arsenic trioxide) are taken and made into fine powder. It is squeezed in between sheets of mica. It is burnt in open air, till the internal mass turns to coppery red color. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Rasamanikya is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation with properties to manage the disease occurring due to vitiation of Vata and kapha doshas. 
 It is a very useful Ayurvedic remedy to bring effective results in respiratory problems. It is helpful in bronchitis, helps to reduce inflammation in bronchi, ease in expectoration of phlegm, and improves the breathing, giving relief in chest pain. It also provides relief in Asthma, dilate the bronchial passage, helps in easy breathing, preventing its recurrence. It can control the cough. Useful medicine to regulate the body temperature in the body. 
 It is even beneficial to manage various chronic skin problems like, leprosy, have properties to heal wounds rapidly and relieves the pus filled boils, disease with excessive dryness of skin, lessen the rashes, helps to get rid of eczema, reduces the inflammations of eczema., leukoderma etc. 
 It is suitable for certain nervous disorders too.

sections.dosage:
125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with ghee and honey.
sections.side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, as it contains Arsenic as an ingredient. 
 Take this medicine for a limited period of time, in precise doses or as advised by the doctor. 
 Over-dosage is dangerous with medicine. 
 This medicine should be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Rasamanikya 
 Reference: Siddha Bheshaja manimala Jwaraprakarana, 66, AFI, Vol. 1. 
 Rasamanikya is an Ayurvedic medicine available in tablet and powder form. This herbal powder is used in the treatment of fever, bronchitis, Asthma etc. This medicine contains heavy metal as an ingredient, hence take it strictly under medical supervision. It balances the Vata and Kapha doshas in the body. 
 Ingredients 
 Shuddha haratala (arsenic trioxide) and mica sheets. 
 Method of preparation 
 Small pieces of Purified Haratala (Arsenic trioxide) are taken and made into fine powder. It is squeezed in between sheets of mica. It is burnt in open air, till the internal mass turns to coppery red color. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Rasamanikya is an efficient Ayurvedic formulation with properties to manage the disease occurring due to vitiation of Vata and kapha doshas. 
 It is a very useful Ayurvedic remedy to bring effective results in respiratory problems. It is helpful in bronchitis, helps to reduce inflammation in bronchi, ease in expectoration of phlegm, and improves the breathing, giving relief in chest pain. It also provides relief in Asthma, dilate the bronchial passage, helps in easy breathing, preventing its recurrence. It can control the cough. Useful medicine to regulate the body temperature in the body. 
 It is even beneficial to manage various chronic skin problems like, leprosy, have properties to heal wounds rapidly and relieves the pus filled boils, disease with excessive dryness of skin, lessen the rashes, helps to get rid of eczema, reduces the inflammations of eczema., leukoderma etc. 
 It is suitable for certain nervous disorders too. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 Gout 
 Chronic wounds 
 Syphilis 
 Rashes 
 Dryness of skin 
 Leucoderma 
 
 Dosage 
 
 125 mg once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is traditionally administered along with ghee and honey. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous, as it contains Arsenic as an ingredient. 
 Take this medicine for a limited period of time, in precise doses or as advised by the doctor. 
 Over-dosage is dangerous with medicine. 
 This medicine should be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 Keep out of reach and sight of children. 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
